_meta.description: Heat sources (crematoria) for Barcelona. PROVISIONAL per project §6.1.
_meta.verification: Cross-checked Nov 2026 against barcelona.cat / ajuntament.barcelona.cat and operator sites. Key finding: as of 2024/2025 the City lists Montjuïc as the operating municipal cremation centre. The Collserola crematorium (3 furnaces opened 1989) was CLOSED in 2019 for failing environmental rules — it is included here as a decommissioned site, not an active source, and must NOT be counted toward addressable heat.
_meta.cremationVolumes: All annualCremations are ESTIMATES. FT Connect telemetry is mocked in this prototype; no site is actually connected. dataConfidence reflects this honestly.

sources.name: Crematori de Montjuïc
sources.address: Mare de Déu de Port, 56-58, 08038 Barcelona
sources.notes: CONFIRMED active: the City's own funeral-services page lists Montjuïc as Barcelona's municipal cremation centre. Site location confirmed; cremator count and annual volume are estimates. FT-equipment flag is a prototype assumption (unverified) — treat the 'connected' advantage as the thing FT would check first.

sources.name: Crematori de Collserola (tancat / decommissioned)
sources.address: Carretera del Cementiri de Collserola, 08035 Barcelona
sources.notes: CLOSED 2019. Three furnaces (opened 1989) shut down for being obsolete and failing environmental rules in the Collserola natural park. Carries NO recoverable heat and must be excluded from addressable-heat totals. Retained to document the site and to flag that re-permitting here is politically loaded.

sources.name: Tanatori Mémora Les Corts
sources.notes: Mémora is a real, long-established Barcelona funeral operator (Les Corts tanatori confirmed). Whether this specific site runs cremators on-premises, their count, equipment make and volumes are all UNVERIFIED estimates. Coordinates approximate. Not FT equipment as far as known.

sources.name: Crematori Áltima Sant Boi
sources.address: Carrer de Saragossa, 6, 08830 Sant Boi de Llobregat
sources.notes: Áltima operates crematoriums in Catalonia and a Sant Boi de Llobregat facility (confirmed). Outside the Barcelona municipal boundary (wider metropolitan area). Cremator count and volumes are estimates; equipment make unknown. Shown to illustrate the private-operator opportunity, with honestly low confidence.
